---
title: "Component image animations"
video:
  width: 1920
  height: 1080
  fps: 30
---

Each compatible animation of the image component, one per scene.

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s" animation="fade-in"}
::: {.image src="assets/landscape.jpg" fit="contain" alt="A teal to rose gradient, landscape"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Fade in: the whole scene fades from transparent.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s" animation="slide-up"}
::: {.image src="assets/portrait.png" fit="cover" alt="A blue to amber gradient, portrait"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Slide up: the scene rises into place.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s" animation="reveal"}
::: {.image src="assets/portrait.png" fit="contain" alt="A blue to amber gradient, portrait"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Reveal: the picture fades in and grows into place.
:::
:::
